title: Implement Coda Property Kind System
description: Implement coda property system with property kinds number/object/array/level/category and kind-specific measure kinds (number: increase/decrease, level: raise/lower, etc). Update runtime resources and config so properties expose their measure kinds.
summary: Implemented canonical Coda property kind system with number/object/array/level/category and kind-specific measure kinds. Added runtime normalization in coda.py so legacy type-based configs map to canonical kind + measure_kinds recursively. Updated target/property resources and sidecar target API to return normalized properties. Refactored coda.json to define property_kinds and canonical property definitions, added measure entries with measure kind metadata, and fixed invalid Berlin target rule structure so the config is parseable.
